topPRs.title: Add NAPS token to Base
topPRs.author: gregbryan-ship-it
topPRs.body:
Adding NAPS (Native Agent Payment System) token to Base. NAPS is an ERC-20 token designed for AI agents to transact autonomously on Base blockchain.

- Contract: 0x1570a3ae65328b2f63b8f71e97b37f82c84fb216
- Website: https://napspayments.io
- Twitter: @NAPSPayments
